_comment: Versioned scoring config for the NG911 triage prioritization engine. Bump scoring_version whenever weights change so historical audit records remain traceable.
_comment_base: Domain-specific base scores replace the single base_score. EMS and hazmat incidents start higher because even an unconfirmed medical call warrants faster response than a vague police call.

indicator_rules.description: Caller reports victim is not breathing — immediate life threat
Cardiac arrest or heart attack reported
Weapon mentioned — elevated danger to victim and responders
Hazardous materials or environmental danger present
Fire is spreading or structure is engulfed
Multiple people affected — base contribution (victim count multiplier adds further)
Caller is in extreme distress — possible indicator of severity
Indicators of a possible non-genuine call

_comment_victim: When victim_count_estimate > 1, add per_additional_victim per extra victim, capped at max_contribution. Null count (unknown multiple) gets half the cap as a conservative estimate.

victim_count_multiplier.description: Score contribution from estimated victim count beyond 1

verification_flags._comment: Flags surface uncertainty for operator verification. They carry no weight: missing location or low parser confidence must never lower an incident's priority.

low_location_confidence.description: Dispatchable location score is low — verify location with caller (does not lower priority)

low_parse_confidence.description: Parser confidence is low — confirm classification (does not lower priority)
